body: ### All Submissions: - [x] Have you followed the guidelines stated in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/reflex-dev/reflex/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) file? - [x] Have you checked to ensure there aren't any other open [Pull Requests](https://github.com/reflex-dev/reflex/pulls) for the desired changed? ### Type of change - [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) ### Changes To Core Features: - [x] Have you added an explanation of what your changes do and why you'd like us to include them? - [x] Have you written new tests for your core changes, as applicable? - [ ] Have you successfully ran tests with your changes locally? (run on GitHub Actions in a fork instead; results below) ### Description `StateManagerRedis.get_state` already gives a tab a fresh state when the stored schema no longer matches, by suppressing `StateSchemaMismatchError`. But `BaseState._deserialize` calls `pickle.loads` before that check, so if a deploy moves or deletes a class held in a state var, unpickling raises `ModuleNotFoundError` or `AttributeError`, which nothing catches. Every event from that tab then fails until the Redis key expires. `_deserialize` now raises `StateSchemaMismatchError` from `AttributeError`, `EOFError`, `ImportError` and `pickle.UnpicklingError`, as suggested in the issue, so the existing fallback applies. That also covers a truncated payload. `StateManagerDisk` already catches every error on load, so its behavior does not change. Tests: - `tests/units/test_state.py::test_deserialize_unreadable_state_raises_schema_mismatch`: module removed, class removed and truncated payload, from bytes and from a file object. - `tests/units/istate/manager/test_redis.py::test_get_state_discards_unpicklable_state`: stores a state that holds an app object, removes the object's module, and checks that `get_state` returns a fresh state. Without the fix, all 7 new tests fail with `ModuleNotFoundError`, `AttributeError` or `UnpicklingError`. With the fix, `uv run pytest tests/units` passes with the mock Redis (9850 passed), with real Redis (9864 passed) and with real Redis plus `REFLEX_OPLOCK_ENABLED=true` (9864 passed). `ruff format --check`, `ruff check` and `pyright` are clean on the touched files. closes #7271
title: fix: replace a stored state that can no longer be unpickled
